| [[File:RG-C1-Quick-Reflexes-All-Wrapped-Up.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_200-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Quick-Reflexes-All-Wrapped-Up.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Quick Reflexes & All Wrapped Up</nowiki> || <nowiki>Effect</nowiki> || <nowiki>2</nowiki> ||  ||  || <nowiki>Deploy on table. | [[File:RG-C1-Scum-And-Villainy-Information-Exchange.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_206-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Scum-And-Villainy-Information-Exchange.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Scum And Villainy & Information Exchange</nowiki> || <nowiki>Effect</nowiki> || <nowiki>3</nowiki> ||  ||  || <nowiki>Deploy on Audience Chamber. (Immune to Alter if you control three Jabba's Palace sites.)</nowiki>

| [[File:RG-C1-Tatooine-Resale-Operations.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_209-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Tatooine-Resale-Operations.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Tatooine Resale Operations</nowiki> || <nowiki>Effect</nowiki> || <nowiki>3</nowiki> ||  || <nowiki>Jawas such as Coilen are known to sell the cheapest droids at the highest prices. | [[File:RG-C1-This-Is-Outrageous-Motion-Supported.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_211-original">[[:File:RG-C1-This-Is-Outrageous-Motion-Supported.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>This Is Outrageous! & Motion Supported</nowiki> || <nowiki>Political Effect</nowiki> || <nowiki>2</nowiki> ||  ||  || <nowiki>Deploy on table. If a wealth agenda here, once per turn, you may lose your just drawn battle destiny to substitute it with a card from hand.</nowiki>

| [[File:RG-C1-Worry.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_217-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Worry.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Worry</nowiki> || <nowiki>Effect</nowiki> || <nowiki>3</nowiki> ||  || <nowiki>It was almost too much for Shmi to take in as she watched her son take part in one of the most dangerous sports in the galaxy.</nowiki> ||

When attempting to cross Luke over (except with Epic Duel), add 3 to total destiny for each card in stack. (Immune to Alter.)</nowiki>

| [[File:RG-C1-Combat-Readiness-Prepared-Defenses.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_228-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Combat-Readiness-Prepared-Defenses.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Combat Readiness & Prepared Defenses</nowiki> || <nowiki>Used Or Starting Interrupt</nowiki> || <nowiki>3</nowiki> ||  ||  || <nowiki>USED: If a battle was just initiated, draw destiny and activate up to that much Force. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.</nowiki>

| [[File:RG-C1-Counter-Surprise-Assault.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_229-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Counter-Surprise-Assault.jpg]]</ref> || [[Counter Surprise Assault (Reflections Gold)|Counter Surprise Assault]] || <nowiki>Lost Interrupt</nowiki> || <nowiki>2</nowiki> || <nowiki>2</nowiki> ||  || <nowiki>Cancel Surprise Assault. | [[File:RG-C1-Dark-Jedi-Presence.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_231-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Dark-Jedi-Presence.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Dark Jedi Presence</nowiki> || <nowiki>Lost Interrupt</nowiki> || <nowiki>3</nowiki> || <nowiki>4</nowiki> ||  || <nowiki>If one of your Dark Jedi is present during any battle, use 1 Force to cause all other Imperials there to battle at double power.</nowiki>
|-
| [[File:RG-C1-Dark-Jedi-Presence-Vader-s-Eye.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_232-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Dark-Jedi-Presence-Vader-s-Eye.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Dark Jedi Presence & Vader's Eye</nowiki> || <nowiki>Lost Interrupt</nowiki> || <nowiki>4</nowiki> ||  ||  || <nowiki>If Vader is defending a battle alone at a site, add 1 to power and add one battle destiny. | [[File:RG-C1-Dark-Maneuvers.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_233-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Dark-Maneuvers.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Dark Maneuvers</nowiki> || <nowiki>Used Interrupt</nowiki> || <nowiki>6</nowiki> || <nowiki>1</nowiki> ||  || <nowiki>Add 2 to maneuver and 1 to power of any starfighter for remainder of turn. If destiny > 2, target's game text is canceled for remainder of turn.</nowiki>

| [[File:RG-C1-Disciplinary-Actions.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_236-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Disciplinary-Actions.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Disciplinary Actions</nowiki> || <nowiki>Used Or Lost Interrupt</nowiki> || <nowiki>4</nowiki> ||  || <nowiki>Vader had to kill someone from time to time just to keep the rest of his officers in check.</nowiki> ||

| [[File:RG-C1-Drop-Your-Weapons-Halt.jpg|200px]]<ref name="15_237-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Drop-Your-Weapons-Halt.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Drop Your Weapons & Halt!</nowiki> || <nowiki>Used Interrupt</nowiki> || <nowiki>4</nowiki> ||  ||  || <nowiki>If your battle droid just fired a blaster and hit a character, all opponent's weapons at same site are lost. Nabrun is lost and all Rebels transported are captured. (Immune to Sense.) OR At any time (except during battle), target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to any one other site. Draw destiny.
